summary: This study looks at treatments for women up to 40 years old who have polycystic ovary syndrome (a hormone condition causing enlarged ovaries with small cysts) and type 2 diabetes (a disease with high blood sugar). Participants are split into two groups to test different medicine combinations along with healthy lifestyle changes. Researchers will check blood sugar levels, weight, and menstrual cycle recovery after three months. The study has a target of 142 participants.
